
# Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited

> Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited is a power systems company based in Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It designs and manufactures online UPS systems from 1 kVA to 1200 kVA, industrial inverters, voltage stabilizers, battery chargers and related power products, and supplies batteries, solar systems and EV chargers.

Official website: https://www.eandcpower.com/

## Company Information

- **Company name:** Electronics & Controls Power Systems Private Limited
- **CIN:** U31200KA1997PTC022448
- **Address:** 29/A, 2nd Phase, Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560058, India
- **Also known as:** E&C Power Systems
- **In power electronics since:** 1978
- **Phone:** 080 2839 7120 (sales) / 080 2837 1974 / 080 2837 9401
- **Email:** sales@eandcpower.com
- **Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM IST
- **Service area:** Products are designed and manufactured in Bengaluru and supplied across India through E&C's sales and service network.
- **Logo:** https://www.eandcpower.com/image/logo2.png

## Products and Solutions

- [Online UPS range](https://www.eandcpower.com/online-ups): Double conversion online UPS from 1 kVA to 1200 kVA.
- [Accenta Online UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/accenta): 1 to 10 kVA.
- [Renata-I Online UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/renata): Transformer-based online UPS, 2 to 30 kVA.
- [Renata-300 Online UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/renata300): 10 to 800 kVA.
- [Renata-DS Online UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/renatacyclone): 10 to 300 kVA.
- [Renata Modular UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/renatamodular): Modular, scalable online UPS, 10 to 1200 kVA.
- [Accenta Rack Mount UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/rack-mount): 1 to 60 kVA.
- [MIL Grade UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/mil-grade): Rugged UPS for defence and harsh environments.
- [IP41 / IP55 Industrial UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/ip-41-55-online-ups): Dust and water protected industrial UPS.
- [Lithium UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/lithium-ups): 1 to 5 kVA.
- [Line Interactive UPS](https://www.eandcpower.com/lineups): 600 VA to 5 kVA.
- [Industrial Inverters](https://www.eandcpower.com/industrial-inverter): 3 to 100 kVA.
- [Domestic Inverters](https://www.eandcpower.com/domestic-Inverters): 600 VA to 5 kVA.
- [Voltage Stabilizers](https://www.eandcpower.com/stabilizer): Oil cooled and air cooled servo stabilizers.
- [Industrial Battery Chargers (FCBC)](https://www.eandcpower.com/industrial-battery-charger-fcbc)
- [SMF Batteries](https://www.eandcpower.com/smf), [Tubular Batteries](https://www.eandcpower.com/tubular-batteries-manufacturing), [AGM / GEL Batteries](https://www.eandcpower.com/agm-gel), [Lithium Ion Batteries](https://www.eandcpower.com/lithium-ion), [Nickel Cadmium Batteries](https://www.eandcpower.com/nickel)
- [Isolation Transformers](https://www.eandcpower.com/isolation) and [Intelligent Static Transfer Switches](https://www.eandcpower.com/intelligent-transfer-switch)
- [Solar Solutions](https://www.eandcpower.com/solar-solutions) and [EV Chargers](https://www.eandcpower.com/ev-chargers)
- [Remote Monitoring](https://www.eandcpower.com/ups-remote-monitoring) and [SNMP Adapters](https://www.eandcpower.com/snmp-adapter)
- [Custom UPS Solutions](https://www.eandcpower.com/custom-solutions)

## Articles

- [Blog](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs)
- [How to Choose an EV Charger for Your Business in India](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/choose-ev-charger-for-business-india): AC or DC, how many kW, which connector, and what your electricity connection can take: a practical guide to choosing EV chargers for a business in India.
- [What Is an Isolation Transformer, and Does Your UPS Need One?](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/isolation-transformer-for-ups): What an isolation transformer does, why it lowers neutral-to-earth voltage and noise, what K-rating means, and when a UPS needs one.
- [Lithium vs Lead-Acid UPS Batteries: Life, Cost and Safety](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/lithium-vs-lead-acid-ups-battery): Lithium (LiFePO4) vs lead-acid UPS batteries compared on life, weight, charging, heat tolerance, safety and total cost, to help you choose.
- [What Is a Modular UPS? N+1 Redundancy Explained](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/modular-ups-n-plus-1-redundancy): How a modular UPS works, what N+1 redundancy means, how to size the modules, and when a modular UPS beats a standalone or parallel UPS.
- [On-Grid vs Off-Grid vs Hybrid Solar Inverter: Which One Do You Need?](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/on-grid-vs-off-grid-vs-hybrid-solar-inverter): How grid-tie, off-grid and hybrid solar inverters differ, what happens in a power cut, and which suits homes, offices and factories in India.
- [UPS Maintenance Checklist: Monthly, Quarterly and Yearly Checks](https://www.eandcpower.com/blogs/ups-maintenance-checklist): A practical UPS maintenance checklist: what to check every month, quarter and year, which parts wear out, and when an AMC makes sense.
